blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Weight / Story

blocks.source: ゼノギアス、ゼノサーガに継ぐ、高橋哲哉氏が監督を務めるRPG。筆者のクリアまでの時間は６２時間。寄り道は程々にしてプレイ。寄り道要素をしっかりこなすと１００時間を越えるらしい。
blocks.translation: A RPG directed by Tetsuya Takahashi, following Xenogears and Xenosaga. It took me 62 hours to clear. I played while taking only a moderate number of detours. Apparently, completing all the side content thoroughly can take over 100 hours.

blocks.source: 巨神、機神と呼ばれる２体の巨大な神の骸の上が物語の舞台。ギアス、サーガと比較して、ファンタジー色がかなり強くなっているが、敵となるのは機神兵と呼ばれる機械の敵達であったりと、ＳＦ色も強い。世界観は新しいが、ストーリー展開は王道。主人公シュルクは機神兵を倒す力を持った剣『モナド』を手に戦いの旅に出る。
blocks.translation: The story takes place atop the corpses of two enormous gods known as the Bionis and the Mechonis. Compared with Gears and Saga, it has a much stronger fantasy flavor, but it also has a strong sci-fi element, with mechanical enemies known as Mechon. The setting is fresh, but the story follows a classic formula. The protagonist, Shulk, sets out on a journey into battle with the Monado, a sword capable of defeating the Mechon.

blocks.source: マップは広大で自由に動き回れる。いわゆる『見えない壁』の様な物も無く、高い場所からジャンプして、水の中に飛び込んだりと好き勝手に世界を動き回れる。雰囲気はジャンプができて、高低差のあるＦＦ１２といった感じ。
blocks.translation: The maps are vast, and you can move around freely. There are no so-called “invisible walls”; you can jump from high places, dive into the water, and roam the world however you please. The overall feel is like Final Fantasy XII with jumping and elevation differences.

blocks.source: さらに……
blocks.translation: Furthermore…

blocks.source: 至る所にアイテムが落ちている。
blocks.translation: Items are scattered everywhere.

blocks.source: 場所毎に生息する魔物が細かく違う。また、ストーリー進行には関わらない強敵の『ユニークモンスター』と戦う事もできる。
blocks.translation: The monsters inhabiting each area differ in subtle ways. You can also fight powerful “Unique Monsters” that have no bearing on story progression.

blocks.source: 怪しい場所に向かうと『秘境』を発見することがある。（経験値が手に入る）
blocks.translation: Heading toward suspicious-looking places may lead you to discover a “Secret Area.” (You receive experience points.)

blocks.source: という具合に、探索する楽しさが出るように工夫がされている。
blocks.translation: In this way, the game is designed to make exploration enjoyable.

blocks.source: １ダンジョンはかなり長めで、ストーリーのテンポはゆっくり。ただでさえマップが広いのに、お使いイベントでプレイ時間を稼ぐ傾向も見られる。正直、物語中盤はプレイしていて、かなりダレたのだけど、物語後半はスケールの大きな展開で盛り上がる。演出力が高いお陰で、作品独自の世界観をうまく表現できているのが大きい。
blocks.translation: Each dungeon is quite long, and the story moves at a slow pace. Despite the maps already being huge, the game also tends to pad playtime with fetch quests. Honestly, I found the middle portion of the story quite tedious to play, but the latter half becomes exciting with its large-scale developments. The game’s strong direction does a great deal to express its unique worldview effectively.

blocks.source: サブイベントとして、クエストが大量に存在する。ただし、大半は「魔物を倒してくれ」「アイテムを集めてきてくれ」等のお使いなので、好みは分かれる。本筋にそこそこ緊迫感があるので、ゆったりクエストなんてやってていいのかという疑問も。ある程度は本筋のついでに可能だけど、時間に余裕がないと辛いかも。
blocks.translation: There are a huge number of quests as side events. However, most are fetch quests such as “Defeat the monsters for me” or “Collect some items for me,” so opinions will vary. Since the main storyline has a fair amount of tension, you may wonder whether it is really appropriate to leisurely take on quests. Some can be completed alongside the main story, but they may be difficult if you do not have much spare time.

blocks.source: クエストの報酬も微妙な物が多くて、余りメリットが感じられないことも多かった。普通に本筋を進めていれば、次から次へと敵がアイテムを落としていくので、装備やお金に不足することが少ない。結局、筆者はメリットの大きいものだけ済ませて、さっさと進めるようにした。
blocks.translation: Many quest rewards are underwhelming, and often do not feel particularly worthwhile. If you simply progress through the main story, enemies will drop items one after another, so you rarely lack equipment or money. In the end, I completed only the quests with substantial benefits and pushed ahead quickly.

blocks.source: クエストがあるならば、本筋のお使いイベントはもっと削ってもよかったんじゃないかなあと。
blocks.translation: If the game already has quests, I feel the fetch events in the main story could have been reduced further.

blocks.source: 主観が入っているかもしれないけど、気になったのは主人公のシュルク。
blocks.translation: This may be subjective, but what stood out to me was the protagonist, Shulk.

blocks.source: 青臭い性格自体が悪いとは思わないけれど、物語中盤に散々悪さをした悪役を土壇場になって、見逃そうとするシーンは、さすがにどうかと思ってしまった。「人間は殺さない」という主張は分かるけれど、拘束ぐらいはしたほうがいいんじゃ……。結局、悪役は『事故』によって都合よく処理される。
blocks.translation: I do not think his naive personality is inherently bad, but I had to question the scene where he tries to let a villain who had committed countless wrongs throughout the middle of the story go free at the last moment. I understand the principle of “I do not kill humans,” but shouldn’t he at least have restrained him…? In the end, the villain is conveniently dealt with through an “accident.”

blocks.source: 戦闘関連のキャラクターボイスが過剰。特に主人公はザコ戦で普通に技を使っただけで、親の仇に斬りかかるような絶叫をする。戦闘勝利時にキャラ同士の掛け合いが入るけれど、レパートリに乏しい。「勝てたのはみんなのおかげだよ」を何百回と聞くことに……。テイルズオブシリーズでこの種のノリに、慣れているはずの僕でも気になるレベル。
blocks.translation: The character voice lines related to battle are excessive. The protagonist in particular lets out a scream as if he were attacking the killer of his parents just from using an ordinary technique in a fight against regular enemies. Characters exchange banter when a battle is won, but the repertoire is limited. You end up hearing “We won thanks to everyone” hundreds of times… Even I, who should be accustomed to this sort of style from the Tales series, found it distracting.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Comfort

blocks.source: 戦闘
blocks.translation: Battle

blocks.source: 戦闘はＦＦ１２等と同様のシームレス。マップ上を歩く敵と、画面切り替えなしでそのまま戦闘になるので快適。ただし、戦闘を仕掛けて終了するまでのスムーズさは「敵を１体倒す毎に、戦利品の宝箱を開ける必要がある」「抜刀・納刀に演出が入る」等の点で、ＦＦ１２と比較すると劣る。特に敵が分散していて、ちまちま１体ずつ倒さなければならない場合はこれが顕著。
blocks.translation: Battles are seamless, much like those in Final Fantasy XII. Since you fight enemies walking around on the map without any screen transition, it is convenient. However, compared with Final Fantasy XII, the process from initiating a battle to finishing it is less smooth because, among other things, you must open a treasure chest containing spoils after defeating each enemy, and drawing and sheathing your weapon triggers an animation. This is especially noticeable when enemies are spread out and you have to defeat them one by one.

blocks.source: リアルタイム型の戦闘システムで、戦闘メンバーは３人まで。プレイヤーは１人だけを操作し、後の２人はＡＩにお任せする形式。細かい作戦の指定はできないが、それなりに賢く戦ってくれる。
blocks.translation: The battle system operates in real time, with up to three battle members. The player controls only one character, while the other two are left to the AI. You cannot specify detailed tactics, but they fight reasonably intelligently.

blocks.source: 仲間キャラクターの中で、まともな回復技を持つキャラは限られる。主人公と回復役を固定すると、選べるメンバーは残り１人となってしまうので、パーティ編成の自由度は実質的に低くなってしまう。ちなみに、主人公は性能的にかなりの特権を持っているので、外しにくい。
blocks.translation: Only a limited number of party members have decent healing techniques. If you keep the protagonist and healer fixed, only one remaining member can be chosen, so the freedom of party composition is effectively quite low. Incidentally, the protagonist has considerable advantages in terms of performance, making him difficult to leave out.

blocks.source: 戦闘システムはネトゲ等に、良くあるヘイト管理の要素を取り入れたもの。敵に狙われているキャラは赤い光で表示されるので、うまく盾役に攻撃が集まるように敵を誘導する必要がある。
blocks.translation: The battle system incorporates the aggro-management mechanics commonly seen in online games. Characters targeted by enemies are indicated by a red light, so you need to lure enemies in a way that concentrates their attacks on your tank.

blocks.source: 主人公の持つ『未来視』という能力によって、敵が危険な攻撃を放つ場合は、事前に警告がされる。これに対して、どうやって防ぐかという判断が要求される。ただし、演出がカットできないので、強敵とのギリギリの戦いでは、ちょっとしつこいかも。
blocks.translation: The protagonist’s ability called “Vision” warns you in advance when an enemy is about to unleash a dangerous attack. You must then decide how to defend against it. However, since the animation cannot be skipped, it can feel a little repetitive during close fights with powerful enemies.

blocks.source: 他にも、色々と細かくあるけれど基本的にオート気味なので、細かな戦術は立てにくい。特に主人公固有の技に重要な物が多いけれど、操作キャラを他に切り替えていた場合は思い通りに使えないのが辛い。この辺は戦闘中にもキャラの切替ができれば、もっと幅が広がったんじゃないかと思う。どちらかというと、戦闘前の準備の方が重要となる。
blocks.translation: There are many other details, but since the system is basically somewhat automated, it is difficult to devise intricate tactics. Many of the protagonist’s unique techniques are particularly important, but if you have switched to another playable character, it is frustrating that you cannot use them as intended. I think the system could have offered more possibilities if you could switch characters during battle. If anything, preparation before battle is more important.

blocks.source: 大型の敵や複数の敵との戦いでは、何をやっているのか分からなくなりやすい上に、激しく処理落ちするのは気になるところ。中盤以降は大型の敵との戦いが多く、技を使う度に処理落ちするという状況が見られた。背景や敵の作り込みが凄い分、Ｗｉｉの限界なのかも……。
blocks.translation: In battles against large or multiple enemies, it is easy to lose track of what is happening, and the severe slowdown is also concerning. From the middle of the game onward, there are many battles against large enemies, and I often encountered situations where the game slowed down every time I used a technique. Given how impressive the backgrounds and enemy designs are, perhaps this is simply the Wii’s limit…

blocks.source: ＭＰに該当する要素は存在せず、一度使った技は時間が経つと、再び使用できるようになる。戦闘が終了すると、ＨＰは高速で回復する。ＲＰＧにありがちな回復の手間が省けるので快適。消耗を気にする必要もないため、探索に没頭できる。ただ、このせいで同格以下の敵との戦いはリスクが小さく緊張感に欠ける傾向も。
blocks.translation: There is no element corresponding to MP; once a technique has been used, it becomes available again after some time. When battle ends, HP recovers rapidly. This is convenient because it eliminates the tedious healing commonly found in RPGs. Since you do not need to worry about resource consumption, you can immerse yourself in exploration. However, this also makes fights against enemies of equal or lower level low-risk and tends to reduce their tension.

blocks.source: このゲーム、かなり妙なレベル補正が設定されているらしく、敵とのレベル差が３以上になると、能力差以上に不利になる仕様がある。特に自分より６以上レベルが高い相手には、対策を取らないと攻撃がほぼ当たらない。僕の場合、サブイベントを程々に進めていたため、レベル不足で経験値稼ぎを強要させられがちだった。
blocks.translation: Apparently, this game has some rather strange level-scaling rules: when the level difference with an enemy reaches three or more, you are placed at a disadvantage beyond what the difference in stats would suggest. In particular, against opponents six or more levels above you, your attacks will almost never hit unless you take countermeasures. In my case, because I had progressed through the side quests moderately, I was often forced to grind for experience due to being underleveled.

blocks.source: また、逆にこちらがレベルを上げ過ぎると、ボス戦は楽勝になる。寄り道要素が多くプレイスタイルによるレベル差が大きいこの作品には、何とも不自由で相応しくない調整だと思うけれど……。
blocks.translation: Conversely, if you level up too much, boss battles become effortless. For a game with so much side content and such large level differences depending on play style, I feel this is an unnecessarily restrictive and inappropriate form of balancing…

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Comfort

blocks.source: マップが非常に広大で、移動を大変に感じるところもあるが、一度行った要所（ランドマーク）には地図画面から、瞬時に移動することができる。全滅時も、同じくランドマークから復活できるし、金の減少などのデメリットも一切なし。これは本当にありがたい機能。
blocks.translation: The maps are extremely vast, and moving around can sometimes feel arduous, but once you have visited a key location (landmark), you can travel there instantly from the map screen. Even after a party wipe, you can revive at a landmark, with no disadvantages such as losing money. This is a truly welcome feature.

blocks.source: マップの切替に付いても、ロード時間はさほど気にならないし、切替の頻度も少ない。広大なマップを、どうやってこの速度でロードしているのか不思議になるほど。
blocks.translation: As for changing maps, loading times are hardly noticeable, and transitions are infrequent. It is almost mysterious how the game loads such vast maps at this speed.

blocks.source: ただし、メニュー画面や店などの画面切替では、頻繁にロードを行う。装備やスキル、アイテムなどの種類は多く、メニューを操作する頻度は多いので、とても気になる。
blocks.translation: However, transitions involving the menu screen and shops load frequently. There are many types of equipment, skills, and items, and you access the menus often, making this very noticeable.

blocks.source: また、ＦＦ７のマテリアの如く装備にジェム（宝石）をはめ込む事で、キャラクターを強化することができるが、これも使い勝手はいまいち。『武器』『頭』『体』『腕』『膝』『足』の６つも装備箇所があるのに、装備を変更する際には、いちいちジェムを外して新しい装備に付け直す必要がある。
blocks.translation: You can also strengthen characters by inserting gems (jewels) into equipment, much like materia in Final Fantasy VII, but this is not particularly user-friendly either. Although there are six equipment slots—“Weapon,” “Head,” “Body,” “Arms,” “Knees,” and “Feet”—you must remove the gems one by one and insert them into the new equipment whenever you change gear.

blocks.source: 他にも、「アイテムや装備の並び順を保持できない」「アイコンにカーソルを合わせないと、アイテム名が見えない」「持ち数制限があって、適時の整理が必要」「装備画面で装備品の一部説明が見えない」等、メニューの使い勝手は今ひとつ。
blocks.translation: In addition, the menu is not particularly user-friendly: you cannot preserve the order of items and equipment, item names are not visible unless you move the cursor over the icons, inventory limits require periodic organization, and some equipment descriptions are not visible on the equipment screen.

blocks.source: 全体的にシステム周りは使うボタンも多く、少々煩雑。クラシックコントローラだと、押しにくいＺＲボタンに重要なキーを割り当てているのが使い辛い。戦闘やメニューでｙボタンがお留守になっているので、これに当てればよかったのに。
blocks.translation: Overall, the systems use many buttons and are somewhat complicated. With the Classic Controller, it is awkward that important commands are assigned to the difficult-to-press ZR button. The Y button is left unused in battle and the menus, so they should have assigned them there.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: 広大なマップの描写がとても美しい。沼地・原生林等、様々な場所を冒険して、世界を堪能することができる。イベントシーンの演出力はかなりの水準。迫力十分で熱い展開を盛り上げる。
blocks.translation: The vast maps are depicted beautifully. You can explore and enjoy a variety of places, including swamps and primeval forests. The direction of the event scenes is quite impressive. They have plenty of impact and heighten the excitement of the intense developments.

blocks.source: キャラクターの姿はアニメ系ではなくリアル系。姿は装備品によって変化する。イベント中のグラフィックにも装備品のグラフィックはしっかり反映される。そのためにムービーを使わないのも好印象。ただ、装備品のデザインは派手過ぎるものが多く、まるで仮装行列状態。イベントシーンではかなりの違和感がある。
blocks.translation: The characters have a realistic rather than anime-style appearance. Their appearance changes according to their equipment, and the equipment graphics are faithfully reflected in event scenes as well. It is also a positive point that the game does not use prerendered movies for this purpose. However, many equipment designs are excessively flashy, making the characters look like they are in a costume parade. They feel quite out of place in event scenes.

blocks.source: 敵の機神兵のデザインは中々良好。ファンタジー色を持った世界観との異質感が作品独自の雰囲気を形作っている。逆に人物のグラフィックは顔とか指とか、細部まで見ると粗も見られる。
blocks.translation: The designs of the enemy Mechon are quite good. Their incongruity with the fantasy-oriented setting creates the work’s distinctive atmosphere. Conversely, the character graphics show rough edges when examined in detail, such as in the faces and fingers.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: フィールド曲のクオリティが特に高く、広大な世界で繰り広げられる冒険を演出する。昼と夜で音楽の雰囲気が変わるのも良い仕事。前半の通常戦闘は地味だが、後半の通常戦闘やイベント戦闘、ユニークモンスターとの戦いが熱い。
blocks.translation: The quality of the field music is especially high, setting the stage for adventures unfolding across a vast world. The changing musical atmosphere between day and night is also a nice touch. The regular battles in the first half are rather unremarkable, but the regular battles in the latter half, event battles, and battles against unique monsters are exciting.

blocks.source: 雑感
blocks.translation: General Impressions

blocks.source: レビューサイトなどで、非常に高評価だったので、期待しながらプレイ。やってみた感じは、『面白かった点』と『不満を感じた点』が入り交じっており、思ったより人を選ぶゲームという印象。
blocks.translation: I played it with high expectations because it received extremely positive reviews on review sites and elsewhere. After playing it, I felt that its “interesting points” and “points of dissatisfaction” were intermingled, giving me the impression that it is a more niche game than I expected.

blocks.source: 最も大きな評価の分かれ目は……
blocks.translation: The biggest dividing point in how it is evaluated is…

blocks.source: 広大なマップの探索
blocks.translation: Exploring vast maps

blocks.source: 豊富なお使いクエスト
blocks.translation: An abundance of fetch quests

blocks.source: この２点を『楽しい』と思えるか、『面倒臭い』と感じるかだと思う。僕はどちらかというと面倒臭いと感じる側なので、不満点もそれなり。作品の雰囲気が近いＦＦ１２等でこういった要素を楽しめたという人ならば、まず、間違いなくこの作品も楽しめるはず。
blocks.translation: I think it comes down to whether you find these two things “fun” or “a hassle.” I tend to find them more of a hassle, so I had my share of complaints. However, if you enjoyed these elements in games with a similar atmosphere, such as FF12, you will almost certainly enjoy this one as well.

blocks.source: 特に敵もマップも機械ばかりになる中盤～後半は『ストーリー』『戦闘』の双方に単調・面倒な部分が多く、中だるみを感じた。とはいえ、後半～終盤に掛けてはストーリーも盛り上がり、取れる戦略・戦術も増えるので、総合的にはそこそこ満足することができた。
blocks.translation: Especially from the middle to latter parts, when both the enemies and maps consist mostly of machines, there are many monotonous and tedious parts in both the “story” and “battle,” and I felt the game dragged in the middle. That said, the story picks up from the latter half toward the end, and the available strategies and tactics increase, so overall I was reasonably satisfied.

texts.ゼノギアス、ゼノサーガに継ぐ、高橋哲哉氏が監督を務めるRPG。筆者のクリアまでの: A RPG directed by Tetsuya Takahashi, following Xenogears and Xenosaga. It took me 62 hours to clear. I played while taking only a moderate number of detours. Apparently, completing all the side content thoroughly can take over 100 hours.
texts.巨神、機神と呼ばれる２体の巨大な神の骸の上が物語の舞台。ギアス、サーガと比較して: The story takes place atop the corpses of two enormous gods known as the Bionis and the Mechonis. Compared with Gears and Saga, it has a much stronger fantasy flavor, but it also has a strong sci-fi element, with mechanical enemies known as Mechon. The setting is fresh, but the story follows a classic formula. The protagonist, Shulk, sets out on a journey into battle with the Monado, a sword capable of defeating the Mechon.
texts.マップは広大で自由に動き回れる。いわゆる『見えない壁』の様な物も無く、高い場所か: The maps are vast, and you can move around freely. There are no so-called “invisible walls”; you can jump from high places, dive into the water, and roam the world however you please. The overall feel is like Final Fantasy XII with jumping and elevation differences.
texts.場所毎に生息する魔物が細かく違う。また、ストーリー進行には関わらない強敵の『ユニ: The monsters inhabiting each area differ in subtle ways. You can also fight powerful “Unique Monsters” that have no bearing on story progression.
texts.怪しい場所に向かうと『秘境』を発見することがある。（経験値が手に入る）: Heading toward suspicious-looking places may lead you to discover a “Secret Area.” (You receive experience points.)
texts.という具合に、探索する楽しさが出るように工夫がされている。: In this way, the game is designed to make exploration enjoyable.
texts.１ダンジョンはかなり長めで、ストーリーのテンポはゆっくり。ただでさえマップが広い: Each dungeon is quite long, and the story moves at a slow pace. Despite the maps already being huge, the game also tends to pad playtime with fetch quests. Honestly, I found the middle portion of the story quite tedious to play, but the latter half becomes exciting with its large-scale developments. The game’s strong direction does a great deal to express its unique worldview effectively.
texts.サブイベントとして、クエストが大量に存在する。ただし、大半は「魔物を倒してくれ」: There are a huge number of quests as side events. However, most are fetch quests such as “Defeat the monsters for me” or “Collect some items for me,” so opinions will vary. Since the main storyline has a fair amount of tension, you may wonder whether it is really appropriate to leisurely take on quests. Some can be completed alongside the main story, but they may be difficult if you do not have much spare time.
texts.クエストの報酬も微妙な物が多くて、余りメリットが感じられないことも多かった。普通: Many quest rewards are underwhelming, and often do not feel particularly worthwhile. If you simply progress through the main story, enemies will drop items one after another, so you rarely lack equipment or money. In the end, I completed only the quests with substantial benefits and pushed ahead quickly.
texts.クエストがあるならば、本筋のお使いイベントはもっと削ってもよかったんじゃないかな: If the game already has quests, I feel the fetch events in the main story could have been reduced further.
texts.主観が入っているかもしれないけど、気になったのは主人公のシュルク。: This may be subjective, but what stood out to me was the protagonist, Shulk.
texts.青臭い性格自体が悪いとは思わないけれど、物語中盤に散々悪さをした悪役を土壇場にな: I do not think his naive personality is inherently bad, but I had to question the scene where he tries to let a villain who had committed countless wrongs throughout the middle of the story go free at the last moment. I understand the principle of “I do not kill humans,” but shouldn’t he at least have restrained him…? In the end, the villain is conveniently dealt with through an “accident.”
texts.戦闘関連のキャラクターボイスが過剰。特に主人公はザコ戦で普通に技を使っただけで、: The character voice lines related to battle are excessive. The protagonist in particular lets out a scream as if he were attacking the killer of his parents just from using an ordinary technique in a fight against regular enemies. Characters exchange banter when a battle is won, but the repertoire is limited. You end up hearing “We won thanks to everyone” hundreds of times… Even I, who should be accustomed to this sort of style from the Tales series, found it distracting.
texts.戦闘はＦＦ１２等と同様のシームレス。マップ上を歩く敵と、画面切り替えなしでそのま: Battles are seamless, much like those in Final Fantasy XII. Since you fight enemies walking around on the map without any screen transition, it is convenient. However, compared with Final Fantasy XII, the process from initiating a battle to finishing it is less smooth because, among other things, you must open a treasure chest containing spoils after defeating each enemy, and drawing and sheathing your weapon triggers an animation. This is especially noticeable when enemies are spread out and you have to defeat them one by one.
texts.リアルタイム型の戦闘システムで、戦闘メンバーは３人まで。プレイヤーは１人だけを操: The battle system operates in real time, with up to three battle members. The player controls only one character, while the other two are left to the AI. You cannot specify detailed tactics, but they fight reasonably intelligently.
texts.仲間キャラクターの中で、まともな回復技を持つキャラは限られる。主人公と回復役を固: Only a limited number of party members have decent healing techniques. If you keep the protagonist and healer fixed, only one remaining member can be chosen, so the freedom of party composition is effectively quite low. Incidentally, the protagonist has considerable advantages in terms of performance, making him difficult to leave out.
texts.戦闘システムはネトゲ等に、良くあるヘイト管理の要素を取り入れたもの。敵に狙われて: The battle system incorporates the aggro-management mechanics commonly seen in online games. Characters targeted by enemies are indicated by a red light, so you need to lure enemies in a way that concentrates their attacks on your tank.
texts.主人公の持つ『未来視』という能力によって、敵が危険な攻撃を放つ場合は、事前に警告: The protagonist’s ability called “Vision” warns you in advance when an enemy is about to unleash a dangerous attack. You must then decide how to defend against it. However, since the animation cannot be skipped, it can feel a little repetitive during close fights with powerful enemies.
texts.他にも、色々と細かくあるけれど基本的にオート気味なので、細かな戦術は立てにくい。: There are many other details, but since the system is basically somewhat automated, it is difficult to devise intricate tactics. Many of the protagonist’s unique techniques are particularly important, but if you have switched to another playable character, it is frustrating that you cannot use them as intended. I think the system could have offered more possibilities if you could switch characters during battle. If anything, preparation before battle is more important.
texts.大型の敵や複数の敵との戦いでは、何をやっているのか分からなくなりやすい上に、激し: In battles against large or multiple enemies, it is easy to lose track of what is happening, and the severe slowdown is also concerning. From the middle of the game onward, there are many battles against large enemies, and I often encountered situations where the game slowed down every time I used a technique. Given how impressive the backgrounds and enemy designs are, perhaps this is simply the Wii’s limit…
texts.ＭＰに該当する要素は存在せず、一度使った技は時間が経つと、再び使用できるようにな: There is no element corresponding to MP; once a technique has been used, it becomes available again after some time. When battle ends, HP recovers rapidly. This is convenient because it eliminates the tedious healing commonly found in RPGs. Since you do not need to worry about resource consumption, you can immerse yourself in exploration. However, this also makes fights against enemies of equal or lower level low-risk and tends to reduce their tension.
texts.このゲーム、かなり妙なレベル補正が設定されているらしく、敵とのレベル差が３以上に: Apparently, this game has some rather strange level-scaling rules: when the level difference with an enemy reaches three or more, you are placed at a disadvantage beyond what the difference in stats would suggest. In particular, against opponents six or more levels above you, your attacks will almost never hit unless you take countermeasures. In my case, because I had progressed through the side quests moderately, I was often forced to grind for experience due to being underleveled.
texts.また、逆にこちらがレベルを上げ過ぎると、ボス戦は楽勝になる。寄り道要素が多くプレ: Conversely, if you level up too much, boss battles become effortless. For a game with so much side content and such large level differences depending on play style, I feel this is an unnecessarily restrictive and inappropriate form of balancing…
texts.マップが非常に広大で、移動を大変に感じるところもあるが、一度行った要所（ランドマ: The maps are extremely vast, and moving around can sometimes feel arduous, but once you have visited a key location (landmark), you can travel there instantly from the map screen. Even after a party wipe, you can revive at a landmark, with no disadvantages such as losing money. This is a truly welcome feature.
texts.マップの切替に付いても、ロード時間はさほど気にならないし、切替の頻度も少ない。広: As for changing maps, loading times are hardly noticeable, and transitions are infrequent. It is almost mysterious how the game loads such vast maps at this speed.
texts.ただし、メニュー画面や店などの画面切替では、頻繁にロードを行う。装備やスキル、ア: However, transitions involving the menu screen and shops load frequently. There are many types of equipment, skills, and items, and you access the menus often, making this very noticeable.
texts.また、ＦＦ７のマテリアの如く装備にジェム（宝石）をはめ込む事で、キャラクターを強: You can also strengthen characters by inserting gems (jewels) into equipment, much like materia in Final Fantasy VII, but this is not particularly user-friendly either. Although there are six equipment slots—“Weapon,” “Head,” “Body,” “Arms,” “Knees,” and “Feet”—you must remove the gems one by one and insert them into the new equipment whenever you change gear.
texts.他にも、「アイテムや装備の並び順を保持できない」「アイコンにカーソルを合わせない: In addition, the menu is not particularly user-friendly: you cannot preserve the order of items and equipment, item names are not visible unless you move the cursor over the icons, inventory limits require periodic organization, and some equipment descriptions are not visible on the equipment screen.
texts.全体的にシステム周りは使うボタンも多く、少々煩雑。クラシックコントローラだと、押: Overall, the systems use many buttons and are somewhat complicated. With the Classic Controller, it is awkward that important commands are assigned to the difficult-to-press ZR button. The Y button is left unused in battle and the menus, so they should have assigned them there.
texts.広大なマップの描写がとても美しい。沼地・原生林等、様々な場所を冒険して、世界を堪: The vast maps are depicted beautifully. You can explore and enjoy a variety of places, including swamps and primeval forests. The direction of the event scenes is quite impressive. They have plenty of impact and heighten the excitement of the intense developments.
texts.キャラクターの姿はアニメ系ではなくリアル系。姿は装備品によって変化する。イベント: The characters have a realistic rather than anime-style appearance. Their appearance changes according to their equipment, and the equipment graphics are faithfully reflected in event scenes as well. It is also a positive point that the game does not use prerendered movies for this purpose. However, many equipment designs are excessively flashy, making the characters look like they are in a costume parade. They feel quite out of place in event scenes.
texts.敵の機神兵のデザインは中々良好。ファンタジー色を持った世界観との異質感が作品独自: The designs of the enemy Mechon are quite good. Their incongruity with the fantasy-oriented setting creates the work’s distinctive atmosphere. Conversely, the character graphics show rough edges when examined in detail, such as in the faces and fingers.
texts.フィールド曲のクオリティが特に高く、広大な世界で繰り広げられる冒険を演出する。昼: The quality of the field music is especially high, setting the stage for adventures unfolding across a vast world. The changing musical atmosphere between day and night is also a nice touch. The regular battles in the first half are rather unremarkable, but the regular battles in the latter half, event battles, and battles against unique monsters are exciting.
texts.レビューサイトなどで、非常に高評価だったので、期待しながらプレイ。やってみた感じ: I played it with high expectations because it received extremely positive reviews on review sites and elsewhere. After playing it, I felt that its “interesting points” and “points of dissatisfaction” were intermingled, giving me the impression that it is a more niche game than I expected.
texts.最も大きな評価の分かれ目は……: The biggest dividing point in how it is evaluated is…
texts.この２点を『楽しい』と思えるか、『面倒臭い』と感じるかだと思う。僕はどちらかとい: I think it comes down to whether you find these two things “fun” or “a hassle.” I tend to find them more of a hassle, so I had my share of complaints. However, if you enjoyed these elements in games with a similar atmosphere, such as FF12, you will almost certainly enjoy this one as well.
texts.特に敵もマップも機械ばかりになる中盤～後半は『ストーリー』『戦闘』の双方に単調・: Especially from the middle to latter parts, when both the enemies and maps consist mostly of machines, there are many monotonous and tedious parts in both the “story” and “battle,” and I felt the game dragged in the middle. That said, the story picks up from the latter half toward the end, and the available strategies and tactics increase, so overall I was reasonably satisfied.
